# How to Kiss Better

> howtokissbetter.com — Expert kissing advice, techniques, and a complete system for becoming an unforgettable kisser.

## About This Site

How to Kiss Better is an educational resource dedicated to the art and science of kissing. The site is authored by C.J. McKenna, author of *Kiss Perfect Now: A Master Class in Kissology*. It covers kissing techniques, first kiss advice, relationship intimacy, the science behind kissing, and common mistakes to avoid.

## The Book

**Kiss Perfect Now: A Master Class in Kissology** — A 183-page guide covering 16 chapters of kissing techniques, from the foundational Mirror Technique to advanced methods for maintaining passion in long-term relationships. Available as an instant PDF and EPUB download.

## Kiss Test

**The Kiss Test** (/kiss-test/): a free 10-question quiz that scores your kissing habits, names your kisser archetype, and shows the two habits already working for you; the full $4.99 report adds the score breakdown, the three habits to fix first, and a 7-day plan.
